finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Accept both keys |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Unset flag is `undefined`, not `false` | Treat unset as off |

The other 8 warnings are real deprecations. `Buffer()`, `fs.exists`, `punycode`, and 5 more. They do not break the build. Worth a pass before v5.
